I put the marker in a top-level `deletedAccounts` collection, not under `internal/`. A marker under `internal/` would break the requirement that nothing stays in `internal/` for the deleted user. It contains no personal data, only two timestamps. I logged this in `.harness/inbox/questions.jsonl`.

**Needed before deploy:** the markers only disappear after 24h if a Firestore TTL policy on `expireAt` is set up in the real project. The emulator doesn't apply TTL, so the tests don't cover this. I logged it in `.harness/inbox/risks.jsonl` with the `gcloud` command.
